The '''''Isilia''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[440 freighter]]<ref name="PC" /> owned and operated by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Adriav Kavos]]. It was crewed by the [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]] [[Gezzov-tak]], the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Nabkess]], and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Segken Tels]].<ref name="PoG1" />
